aboutText: With over 10 years of experience serving Melbourne, Onpoint Locksmith has built a reputation for reliability and swift service. Our team of certified locksmiths is available 24/7 to handle any lock-related emergency, from home lockouts to security upgrades. We pride ourselves on using high-quality materials and providing transparent pricing to ensure our customers feel safe and secure.
servicesText: At Onpoint Locksmith, we offer a comprehensive range of locksmith services tailored for homes and businesses across Melbourne. From emergency lockouts to advanced security installations, our skilled technicians ensure your peace of mind with prompt and professional solutions.

services.title: Emergency Lockout Services
services.desc: We provide 24/7 emergency lockout assistance for homes and businesses, ensuring you regain access quickly and safely.

services.title: Key Extraction & Repair
services.desc: Our technicians expertly handle snapped key extraction and burglary repairs, restoring your locks to optimal condition.

services.title: Lock Installation & Replacement
services.desc: From deadbolt installation to complete lock replacements, we offer reliable solutions to enhance your property's security.

services.title: Window & Door Security
services.desc: We specialize in securing windows and sliding doors with high-quality locks to prevent unauthorized entry.

services.title: Master Key Systems
services.desc: We design and install master key systems and restricted key suites for convenient access control in commercial settings.

services.title: Access Control Solutions
services.desc: Our access control and swipe systems provide advanced security for offices and retail spaces, integrating seamlessly with your setup.

bannerSubheading: Look no further — our team is here to help.
